BiblicalUsage: Will is the word for a resolve, a purpose settled — and it appears three times. In Romans 9:19 Paul asks, who hath resisted his will? In Acts 27:43 the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept the soldiers from killing the prisoners. And in 1 Peter 4:3 Peter says the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the will in Romans is the question and the will in Acts is the answer: who resists God's will, and yet a centurion's will saved Paul's life — God works through both.
